payload.name: Standby: Theme Park Companion
payload.description: 主题乐园等候时间、开放时间和信息
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Spend less time searching and more time enjoying your park day. Standby brings attraction wait times, ride status, showtimes, and park hours into your ChatGPT conversation.

Explore supported Disney, Universal, and other theme parks, compare waits, and decide what to do next—whether you’re planning your visit or already inside the park!
payload.longDescription:
少花时间搜索，多享受乐园之旅。Standby 会将游乐设施等候时间、运行状态、演出时间和乐园开放时间带入你的 ChatGPT 对话。

探索受支持的 Disney、Universal 等主题乐园，比较等候时间并决定接下来做什么——无论你是在规划行程，还是已经身处乐园！

payload.name: Slothy by CRMaps
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Slothy is your local companion for discovering Costa Rica. It helps users explore destinations, places to visit, restaurants, activities, businesses, and practical information using content published and verified by CRMaps. It provides concise recommendations, direct links, and images when available. When information is not confirmed, it says so clearly. It is read-only: it does not make reservations, process payments, or modify information.
payload.longDescription: Slothy 是你探索哥斯达黎加的本地伙伴。它利用由 CRMaps 发布并核实的内容，帮助用户了解目的地、景点、餐厅、活动、商家和实用信息。信息可用时，它会提供简明推荐、直接链接和图片。若信息未经确认，它会明确说明。此工具为只读，不会预订、处理付款或修改信息。

payload.name: Flightcat
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Flightcat searches airfare for one-way, round-trip, and multi-city trips, resolves broad and fuzzy locations and flexible dates, and displays up to 10 flight options with prices, schedules, stops, and booking links.
payload.longDescription: Flightcat 可搜索单程、往返和多城市行程的机票，识别宽泛或模糊的地点及灵活日期，并最多展示 10 个航班选项，包括价格、时刻表、中转信息和预订链接。

payload.name: Easybook
payload.description: 预订巴士、渡轮及火车行程
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search live bus, ferry, and train schedules and fares with Easybook. Compare available trips across Malaysia, Singapore, and Southeast Asia to find convenient travel options for your journey.
payload.longDescription: 通过Easybook搜索实时的巴士、渡轮和火车时刻表及票价。在马来西亚、新加坡和东南亚地区比较可用的行程，找到适合您旅程的便捷出行选项。

payload.name: VIPCars.com
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search and compare live car rental prices at airports with VIPCars.com. Review available rental cars by vehicle type, supplier, price, rental policies, inclusions, mileage, deposit, and customer rating. Select a deal and continue to VIPCars.com to complete your booking. You can also retrieve an existing reservation using the booking reference and matching email address, then access options to manage it.
payload.longDescription: 通过VIPCars.com在机场搜索并比较实时租车价格。通过车型、供应商、价格、租赁政策、包含项目、里程数、押金及客户评分来查看可用的租车选项。选择优惠套餐，然后继续前往VIPCars.com完成预订。您也可以通过预订参考号及匹配的电子邮件地址检索现有预订，然后访问管理选项。

payload.name: Solartrip
payload.description: 为您行程定制的住宿体验
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Discover your next stay directly in ChatGPT, and let Solartrip take care of the details so you can enjoy the journey.

- Explore a wide selection of stays, from serene villas and spa hotels to lively city apartments, based on your destination, travel dates, and preferences.
- Found the right stay? Continue to Solartrip.com to check the latest price and booking conditions, then complete your reservation.
- Pay your way on Solartrip.com with a credit or debit card or with cryptocurrency.
- Make every stay more rewarding with Solar Cash, earned after your stay and ready to use on future hotel bookings.
- Travel with peace of mind and connect with Solartrip’s 24/7 support team whenever you need help.
payload.longDescription:
在ChatGPT中直接发现您的下一次住宿选择，让Solartrip处理细节，让您专注享受旅程。

- 根据您的目的地、出行日期和偏好，探索从宁静别墅、水疗酒店到活力城市公寓的多样住宿选择。
- 找到合适的住宿？
前往Solartrip.com查看最新价格和预订条件，完成预订。
- 通过Solartrip.com使用信用卡/借记卡或加密货币支付。
- 通过Solar Cash让每次住宿更值得，入住后获得的Solar Cash可用于未来酒店预订。
- 24/7全天候支持团队随时为您服务，出行更安心。

payload.name: MOT Check
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Check any UK-registered car, van or motorcycle's MOT using official DVSA test records. Give it a registration and you get whether the vehicle has a valid MOT and when it expires, when a newer vehicle's first MOT is due, and the result, mileage, advisories and defects from its latest test — plus the full MOT history going back through every recorded test.

The history check flags whether recorded mileage ever went down between tests, a common sign of clocking or a recording error, which is worth knowing before buying a used car. Advisories and failures come back in plain language rather than DVSA shorthand.

Data comes from the DVSA MOT History API, the official UK government record of MOT tests, with tax and MOT status from the DVLA. Every answer links to the vehicle's full record on motcheck.io.

No account or sign-in is needed. MOT records contain no personal information about a vehicle's keeper. UK-registered vehicles only (Great Britain and Northern Ireland).
payload.longDescription:
通过官方DVSA测试记录，可检查任何英国注册的汽车、货车或摩托车的MOT信息。输入车牌号即可获取车辆是否拥有有效MOT、有效期至何时、新车首次MOT何时到期，以及最近一次检测的结果、里程数、建议事项和缺陷记录——还包括追溯至每次记录的完整MOT历史。

历史记录会标记两次检测间里程数是否出现下降，这通常是调表或记录错误的迹象，了解这一点对购买二手车非常重要。建议事项和故障信息会以通俗易懂的语言呈现，而非DVSA的缩写术语。

数据来源于DVSA MOT历史API，即英国政府官方的MOT检测记录，包含来自DVLA的税费和MOT状态信息。每个查询结果都会链接至motcheck.io上的车辆完整记录。

无需账户或登录即可使用。MOT记录不包含车辆所有人的个人信息。仅支持英国注册车辆（大不列颠及北爱尔兰地区）。

payload.name: Voyscout.com
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Voyscout publishes historical flight and package price observations for 47 destinations. Its five read-only tools let users browse destinations and measured spans, retrieve a destination's history (with resort aliases identified), compare latest measurements with their own histories, rank observed rails against their historical data, and compare 2–8 destinations side by side in the order requested.

These are observations, not live quotes or buy recommendations. Voyscout does not book trips or provide booking links. Prices use CZK, and the published dataset is reusable under CC BY 4.0 with attribution. Measured spans, price coverage and freshness details are given where each tool provides them; flight origins are reported as clusters that may not cover every published price. No account, authentication or API key is required.
payload.longDescription:
Voyscout为47个目的地提供历史航班及包裹价格数据。其五个只读工具允许用户浏览目的地和测量时间段，获取特定目的地的历史数据（包含识别的度假村别名），将最新测量数据与自身历史数据对比，根据历史数据对观测到的票价进行排序，以及按用户指定顺序并排对比2-8个目的地。

以上数据为历史观测记录，非实时报价或购买建议。Voyscout不提供行程预订或预订链接。价格单位为捷克克朗（CZK），发布数据集可依据CC BY 4.0协议进行再使用并需注明来源。各工具会提供对应的测量时间段、价格覆盖范围及更新信息，航班出发地以聚类形式展示，可能无法覆盖所有发布价格。使用无需账户、认证或API密钥。

payload.name: BEACON by Owner Connect
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
BEACON lets you talk to a specific private aircraft. Each aircraft's owner decides what BEACON may say about it, and nothing else is shared.

Ask about a tail number to see what public record says about it (the FAA registration, the airframe and engines, registry history) and the facts its owner approved, such as type, year and passenger seats.

Planning a trip? Ask what a route would cost, for example Teterboro to Miami. BEACON works out the flight time from the owner's own numbers and gives an approximate total, including positioning from where the aircraft is parked when the owner charges for it. It is never a quote: the booking contact confirms the price.

Ready to go ahead? BEACON can send your trip request, or a buyer's inquiry, straight to the person the owner named. You confirm by email first, and nothing is sent until you do.

BEACON never books a flight, holds an aircraft or takes payment. Any flight is arranged and operated by a certificated operator. No asking price is ever published.
payload.longDescription:
BEACON让你与特定的私人飞机进行对话。
每架飞机的机主决定BEACON可以透露哪些信息，其他内容均不会共享。

查询飞机尾号即可查看公开记录中的信息（包括FAA注册信息、机身和发动机详情、登记历史），以及机主核准的资料，例如机型、年份和乘客座位数。

计划行程时？
可以询问航线费用，例如从特特博罗到迈阿密。
BEACON会根据机主提供的数据计算飞行时间，并给出包含飞机调机费用的预估总费用（调机费用根据飞机停放位置计算）。
这始终不是正式报价：需经预订联系人确认价格后方可生效。

准备继续？
BEACON可将你的行程请求，或买家咨询，直接发送给机主指定的联系人。
需先通过邮件确认，待确认后信息才会发送。

BEACON从不预订航班、保留飞机或收取费用。
任何航班均由持牌运营商安排和运营。
绝不会公布任何报价。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Look up a private aircraft by tail number, Estimate an approximate charter cost for a route, Send a trip request to the owner's booking contact, Send a buyer's inquiry to the owner's representative

payload.name: Trains on Map
payload.description: 实时火车地图与延误信息
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Live answers about passenger trains in 12 countries: where a train is now, how late it is, which stops it has left, what is leaving a station and from which platform, service alerts, and how punctual a train has been. Every answer carries a link to the same train or station on the live map. Read-only and account-free: it cannot book, cancel or pay for a ticket. Data handling: https://trainsonmap.com/privacy
payload.longDescription:
提供12个国家乘客火车的实时信息：当前火车位置、晚点情况、已经过的站点、车站有哪些列车发车及对应的站台、服务警报，以及火车的准点记录。
每个信息条目都包含通往实时地图上对应火车或车站的链接。
只读且无需账户：无法订票、取消或支付车票。
数据处理政策：https://trainsonmap.com/privacy

payload.name: DroneClear Thailand
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Planning to fly a drone in Thailand? Enter your drone (model or weight), whether it has a camera, where you will fly and why. DroneClear Thailand tells you what you need — CAAT and NBTC registration, the 1,000,000 THB third-party insurance and the main flight rules — each with its source, and which registration or insurance service fits, with a link to droneclearthailand.com. Info only, not legal advice; no personal data is collected in ChatGPT. Antworten auch auf Deutsch.
payload.longDescription:
计划在泰国驾驶无人机吗？
输入您的无人机（型号或重量）、是否带有摄像头、您将在何处飞行以及原因。
DroneClear Thailand会告知您所需信息——CAAT和NBTC注册、1,000,000泰铢第三者责任保险以及主要飞行规则——每项都有来源，并推荐适合的注册或保险服务，并附上droneclearthailand.com的链接。
信息仅供参考，不是法律建议；ChatGPT不会收集任何个人数据。
Antworten auch auf Deutsch.

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Check Thailand drone rules for a drone, place and purpose, Explain CAAT and NBTC registration and the insurance requirement, with sources, Answer in English or German

payload.name: Stymie Golf
payload.description: 寻找高尔夫球场。规划您的比赛。
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find golf courses near a town, transit station, address or US ZIP, then build a shortlist for your next golf trip. Filter by public or private access, hole count and published tee yardage or slope. Explore course details, scorecards, architects, golf equipment and recently checked deals with links to Stymie.

Stymie reads public directory data without an account. Course cards help you compare picks and open the original pages. Coverage varies by country and course. Distances are straight-line estimates; confirm access, seasonal opening and availability directly with each course. Stymie does not book tee times, process payments, enroll you in alerts or access private account data. Equipment offer links may earn Stymie a commission at no extra cost to you.
payload.longDescription:
在城镇、交通枢纽、地址或美国邮政编码附近查找高尔夫球场，然后为您的下一次高尔夫旅行建立短名单。
按公共或私人访问权限、洞数以及已发布的发球台码距或坡度进行筛选。
探索球场详情、记分卡、建筑师、高尔夫装备以及与Stymie链接的最近检查优惠。

Stymie无需账户即可读取公共目录数据。
球场卡片帮助您比较选择并打开原始页面。
覆盖范围因国家和球场而异。
距离为直线估算；请直接与每个球场确认访问权限、季节性开放时间和可用性。
Stymie不预订发球时间、处理支付、为您注册警报或访问私人账户数据。
设备优惠链接可能在不增加您任何费用的情况下为Stymie带来佣金。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Find nearby golf courses, Build golf trip shortlists, Read course details and scorecards, Explore architects and course rankings, Compare equipment and recently checked deals

payload.name: Cria.al
payload.description: 在阿尔巴尼亚寻找租车服务
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find and compare rental cars for a trip to Albania with Cria.al, a marketplace of local rental companies. Tell ChatGPT where and when you need a car, and it searches live availability at Tirana International Airport, Kukës International Airport and cities across the country, including Tirana, Durrës, Vlorë, Sarandë, Shkodër, Berat, Gjirokastër and Korçë.

Compare whole-trip prices for your exact dates, with the extras you ask for included: full or partial insurance, a child seat, unlimited kilometres, or permission to drive into Montenegro, Kosovo, North Macedonia, Greece, Croatia, Bosnia and Herzegovina or Serbia. Narrow the search by automatic or manual gearbox, car type (from small city cars to SUVs, 4x4s and vans), fuel, number of seats, budget, or cars without a security deposit, and plan one-way rentals between two locations.

For any car, see its specs, photos, deposit, pickup and return locations with delivery fees, the rental company's opening hours and rating, the minimum rental days, the minimum driver age, how long cancellation stays free, the payment methods accepted at pickup and the price of each extra. When you have chosen, you get a link to book that car on cria.al with your trip filled in.

Search works without signing in. The tools read public listings and do not reserve cars, take payments, manage existing reservations or access account information. Availability and the final price are confirmed at checkout on cria.al, and the rental company then accepts or declines the request.
payload.longDescription:
通过Cria.al预订阿尔巴尼亚租车，这是一个本地租车公司的市场。向ChatGPT说明您需要用车的时间和地点，它将实时搜索地拉那国际机场、库克斯国际机场以及全国各城市的租车信息，包括地拉那、都拉斯、发罗拉、萨兰达、斯库台、伯尔特、吉诺卡斯特和科赤的可用情况。

比较您具体日期的全程价格，并包含您要求的附加服务：全险或部分保险、儿童座椅、无限里程或允许驶入黑山、科索沃、北马其顿、希腊、克罗地亚、波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那或塞尔维亚的许可。根据自动或手动变速箱、车型（从小型城市车到SUV、四驱车和面包车）、燃油类型、座位数、预算或无需押金的车辆进行筛选，并规划两地之间的单程租车。

查看每款车型的参数、照片、押金、取还车地点及配送费用，租车公司的营业时间与评分，最低租期、最低驾驶年龄、免费取消时限、提车时接受的支付方式以及各项附加服务的价格。选定车辆后，您将获得一个跳转至cria.al的链接，并自动填入您的行程信息。

搜索功能无需登录即可使用。这些工具仅读取公开列表，不会预订车辆、收取费用、管理现有预订或访问账户信息。可用性和最终价格将在cria.al结账时确认，随后租车公司会接受或拒绝该请求。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search rental cars across Albania, Compare whole-trip prices, Check a car for specific dates, Find pickup and return locations, including airports, Filter by gearbox, car type, seats, fuel, budget and deposit, Plan one-way and cross-border trips, Read vehicle details and rental rules

payload.name: ate
payload.description: 将食物照片保存为贴纸
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
ate turns the food you eat into a sticker collection. Send a photo of a meal to ChatGPT and ask ate to save it: ChatGPT names the dish, and ate files it in your collection with its cuisine and the country it comes from. Next time you open the ate app on Android, the dish has been cut out of the photo as a sticker and placed in your collection and on your food map.

You can also ask about what you have eaten: what you had in a city or on a trip, how many cuisines you have tried, or when you last had a dish.

What ate does in ChatGPT:
- Saves a food photo you share to your ate collection, with the date and place you mention.
- Shows a card with the photo, the dish, its cuisine and country, and a button to open the app.
- Answers questions about your collection.

ate only keeps photos of real food. A photo that is not a meal, or shows a whole table of dishes, is not saved, and ChatGPT tells you why. ate never sees the rest of your conversation.

You need an ate account: get the app on Google Play and sign in with the same account when you connect.
payload.longDescription:
ate会将你吃的食物转化为贴纸收藏。向ChatGPT发送餐食照片并请求ate保存：ChatGPT会命名这道菜品，并根据其所属菜系和国家对照片进行归档。下次打开安卓版ate应用时，这道菜品已从照片中裁剪为贴纸，自动归入你的收藏夹和食物地图中。

你也可以询问自己曾吃过的食物：在某个城市或旅行中吃了什么、尝试过多少种菜系，或者上次吃某道菜是什么时候。

在ChatGPT中，ate的功能包括：
- 保存你分享的食物照片至ate收藏夹，并标注你提到的日期和地点
- 展示包含照片、菜品名称、所属菜系和国家的卡片，并附有打开应用的按钮
- 回答关于你收藏内容的问题

ate仅保存真实食物的照片。
若照片不是单道菜品，或显示整桌菜肴，该照片将不会被保存，ChatGPT会告知你具体原因。ate不会查看你对话中的其他内容。

你需要拥有ate账户：在Google Play下载应用，并在连接时使用同一账户登录。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Save food photos to your collection, Look up what you ate and where

payload.name: HostelHound
payload.description: 搜索并规划青年旅社旅行
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: HostelHound helps travelers search tracked destinations and hostels, compare accommodation price context, review qualitative price forecasts, get deterministic hostel recommendations, quote and validate accommodation-only itineraries, and prepare an expiring trip proposal for review in the HostelHound browser. The app does not book, purchase, save, share, watch, or notify from ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: HostelHound帮助旅行者搜索跟踪目的地和青年旅社，比较住宿价格背景，查看定性价格预测，获取精准的青年旅社推荐，报价并验证仅含住宿的行程方案，并在HostelHound浏览器中准备可过期的行程提案以供审核。该应用不通过ChatGPT进行预订、购买、保存、分享、监控或通知。

payload.name: GdeNaPlaninu smeštaj
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search active GdeNaPlaninu properties and accommodation units by destination, type, amenities, indicative price and dates. Explore interactive listing cards, photos and videos. Prepare an inquiry with your first name, last name, email, phone and message, review it and send it to the owner only after explicit confirmation. Inquiries do not create reservations or take payments. Confirm prices and availability directly with the owner.
payload.longDescription:
通过目的地、类型、设施、参考价格和日期搜索GdeNaPlaninu的活跃房源和住宿单元。
浏览互动式房源卡片、照片和视频。
填写您的名、姓、邮箱、电话和留言，确认信息无误后发送至房东。
询盘不会创建预订或收取费用。
请直接与房东确认价格和可用性。

payload.name: GetRide
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Use GetRide in ChatGPT to get synthetic demo ride quotes and check synthetic demo ride status. This initial ChatGPT integration demonstrates GetRide’s transportation experience in ChatGPT. It does not yet expose the broader GetRide rider, driver, service-seeker, booking, payment, bidding, or account-management features, and it does not access production ride data.
payload.longDescription:
在ChatGPT中使用GetRide可获取模拟乘车报价并检查模拟乘车状态。
此次初始的ChatGPT集成展示了GetRide在ChatGPT中的交通体验。
目前尚未展示GetRide的更广泛功能，包括乘客、司机、服务需求方、预订、支付、竞价或账户管理功能，且不访问生产环境的乘车数据。

payload.name: Discriminantly
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Keep the things you notice, the places you go, and the experiences worth remembering with Discriminantly. Add to your collection naturally through conversation with ChatGPT, revisit what you’ve kept, organize interests and travels, and turn the places you’re considering into itineraries and plans. The more you keep, the more context you have at hand when you want to remember, explore, or plan what comes next.
payload.longDescription: 用Discriminantly保存您注意到的事物、去过的地点以及值得铭记的体验。通过与ChatGPT的对话自然地添加到您的收藏，回顾已保存的内容，整理兴趣与行程，并将正在考虑的地点转化为行程规划。您保存的内容越多，当您需要回忆、探索或规划下一步时，就能拥有更多的上下文信息。

payload.name: VoltShare
payload.description: 找到您附近的电动汽车充电桩
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: VoltShare is an EV charging marketplace that puts public and private EV chargers on one map. This connector lets ChatGPT search for EV chargers near any address or coordinates and pull full details — connector type (J1772, CCS, NACS, Tesla), power output, price per kWh, live availability, hours, and host info — so drivers can find a compatible charger before committing to the trip. Tools: Search EV chargers (distance-sorted results filtered by connector type, max price per kWh, minimum power, and availability) and Get EV charger details (full profile for any charger, including pricing, live status, and host). Read-only: the connector never books, reserves, or charges anything — it only discovers chargers.
payload.longDescription: VoltShare是一个电动汽车充电桩市场，将公共和私人电动汽车充电桩整合到一张地图上。该插件可让ChatGPT根据任意地址或坐标搜索附近充电桩，并获取完整信息——包括充电接口类型（J1772、CCS、NACS、特斯拉）、功率输出、每千瓦时价格、实时可用性、营业时间及运营商信息，帮助驾驶员在出行前找到兼容的充电桩。工具功能：搜索电动汽车充电桩（按距离排序的结果，可筛选充电接口类型、最高每千瓦时价格、最低功率和可用性）和获取充电桩详情（查看任意充电桩的完整信息，包括定价、实时状态和运营商信息）。只读模式：该插件仅用于发现充电桩，不会进行预订、预留或收费操作。

payload.name: restplass.no
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Tilgang for agenter til Norges største markedsplass for charter- og pakkereiser
payload.longDescription: 代理商访问挪威最大的包机和包价旅游市场平台

payload.name: SelectBNBs Verify
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
SelectBNBs Verify checks accommodation permits for short-term rentals in South Korea using official government registry data.

Paste a listing’s Registration details—region of issuance, licence type and licence number—or provide a registered business name, address or government management number. Verify returns the matching permit’s recorded status, registered business, permit category and address, with source dates and record links when available. It explains how closely the submitted details match the record and what to compare before booking.

Each request checks one listing or retrieves one permit record. South Korea is currently supported; other countries are reported as not covered. A missing match does not establish that a property is unregistered or illegal, and an active permit does not by itself confirm a listing’s identity. No account or sign-in is required. Verify does not book, pay or contact anyone.
payload.longDescription:
SelectBNBs Verify通过官方政府注册数据，核查韩国短期租赁的住宿许可。

粘贴房源的注册信息——签发地区、许可证类型和许可证号码，或提供已注册的公司名称、地址或政府管理编号。核查结果将显示匹配许可的记录状态、注册公司、许可类别和地址，以及可用的来源日期和记录链接。它会说明提交信息与记录的匹配程度，并提示预订前需要对比的内容。

每次请求仅核查一个房源或获取一个许可记录。目前仅支持韩国；其他地区显示为不覆盖。未找到匹配项并不意味着该房产未注册或非法，有效许可本身也不代表确认房源身份。无需账户或登录。Verify不进行预订、支付或联系任何人员。

payload.name: Tripsy
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Tripsy helps travelers plan, organize, and manage their trips directly from ChatGPT. Connect your Tripsy account to access itineraries, destinations, reservations, activities, notes, and other trip details, so ChatGPT can answer trip questions, summarize plans, suggest next steps, and help keep your travel information organized before and during your journey.

Example prompts

- “Show me my itinerary for Paris next week.”
- “What reservations do I have on the first day of my trip?”
- “Summarize my upcoming Japan trip.”
- “Help me find gaps in my itinerary.”
- “What activities are planned near my hotel?”
- “Create a day-by-day overview of my trip.”

Use cases

- Review upcoming trips and daily plans
- Find reservations, activities, notes, and key details faster
- Summarize complex itineraries into simple overviews
- Prepare for travel days with checklists and reminders
- Ask natural-language questions about your saved trip plans
- Get help organizing ideas while building your itinerary

Travel with Tripsy anywhere
Tripsy is also available as a native app for iPhone, iPad, and Mac, so you can access and manage your trips during your journey. The native app supports offline access, making your itinerary available even when connectivity is limited.
payload.longDescription:
Tripsy帮助旅行者直接通过ChatGPT规划、组织和管理旅行。连接您的Tripsy账户以访问行程、目的地、预订、活动、笔记和其他旅行详情，这样ChatGPT就能回答旅行问题、总结计划、建议下一步行动，并帮助您在旅程开始前和进行中保持旅行信息的有序性。

示例提示

- 「显示我下周的巴黎行程。」
- 「我旅行的第一天有哪些预订？」
- 「总结我的日本之旅。」
- 「帮我找出行程中的空白点。」
- 「我酒店附近有什么活动安排？」
- 「创建我的旅行逐日概览。」

使用场景

- 回顾即将开始的行程和每日计划
- 更快速地查找预订、活动、笔记和关键细节
- 将复杂的行程简化为概要视图
- 通过检查清单和提醒准备旅行日
- 以自然语言询问您保存的旅行计划
- 在构建行程时获得帮助整理思路

随Tripsy畅行天下
Tripsy还提供原生iPhone、iPad和Mac应用，您可以在旅途中访问和管理行程。原生应用支持离线访问，在网络连接受限时也能确保行程可用。

payload.name: Atlas Planner
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Plan and share your next trip with your partner, family or friends in a single place.
payload.longDescription: 与伴侣、家人或朋友在同一个地方计划并分享您的下一次旅行。

payload.name: TrainBrain
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Search live and scheduled UK rail services, inspect calling points and available formations, and check a train’s latest reported progress. Compare bounded journey options with up to three changes and create interactive route maps, static snapshots and service-progress images.

TrainBrain uses Realtime Trains data. Running information may change or be unavailable. Locations reflect actual timing reports and are not GPS. Journey searches are not exhaustive and do not verify official minimum interchange times. TrainBrain does not sell tickets or guarantee connections.
payload.longDescription:
搜索实时及计划中的英国铁路服务，查看停靠站点和可用车厢，查看火车的最新报告进度。对比最多包含三次换乘的行程方案，创建交互式路线图、静态截图和服务进度图。

TrainBrain使用Realtime Trains数据。运行信息可能发生变化或无法获取。位置信息基于实际时间报告，非GPS定位。行程搜索不全面，不验证官方最短换乘时间。TrainBrain不售卖车票也不保证换乘衔接。

payload.name: MiqatAir
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
MiqatAir helps Muslim travellers plan prayer during commercial flights. Provide a flight number and departure date to receive an in-flight prayer plan calculated by MiqatAir. If more than one route matches, choose the departure and arrival airports. Flight information is obtained from the valid MiqatAir cache or AeroDataBox Direct. Prayer times calculated by MiqatAir.

Access requires a MiqatAir account approved manually. Request access through our support page before connecting; a ChatGPT account alone does not grant access. Access is free and subject to capacity. Limits: 3 searches per minute and 20 per day per user, including repeated searches.

The separate MiqatAir application provides airport or on-board prayer guidance, recommended Qibla timing when available, and reminders in the selected language when enabled and permitted by the device. The ChatGPT tool itself does not send notifications, make bookings or take payments.

Flight trajectories and prayer plans are estimates. Check the flight, departure date and time zone, follow crew safety instructions, and consult qualified religious guidance when needed. MiqatAir calculates the prayer plan; AeroDataBox Direct is the flight-data provider.
payload.longDescription:
MiqatAir帮助穆斯林旅客规划商业航班中的祈祷时间。输入航班号和出发日期，即可获得MiqatAir计算的机上祈祷计划。若存在多个匹配航线，请选择出发和到达机场。航班信息来源于有效的MiqatAir缓存或AeroDataBox Direct。MiqatAir计算祈祷时间。

访问需经过人工审批的MiqatAir账户。连接前请通过我们的支持页面申请访问权限；仅拥有ChatGPT账户无法获得访问权限。访问免费且受容量限制。限制：每分钟3次搜索，每位用户每天20次搜索（包括重复搜索）

独立的MiqatAir应用程序提供机场或机上祈祷指引，可在有推荐时显示Qibla方向时间，并在启用且设备允许的情况下以选定语言发送提醒。ChatGPT工具本身不会发送通知、预订或处理支付

航班轨迹和祈祷计划为估算值。请核对航班信息、出发日期和时区，遵循机组人员安全指示，并在需要时咨询合格的宗教指导。MiqatAir负责计算祈祷计划；AeroDataBox Direct为航班数据提供商。

payload.name: Mimo
payload.description: 查找附近的充电宝站点
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Mimo helps users find nearby active power bank stations, check device and return-slot availability, review working hours, and retrieve the active rental tariffs for a chosen station.
payload.longDescription: Mimo帮助用户查找附近的可用充电宝站点，检查设备和还机位的可用性，查看营业时间，并获取所选站点的当前租赁费率。

payload.name: EscapeStays by Luxury Lodging
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: EscapeStays is the direct booking site of Luxury Lodging, a professional property manager with about 250 vacation rental homes across the United States. Search homes by place, dates, guests, bedrooms, pets and amenities; check live availability; get a real stay total that already includes cleaning, fees and taxes; and compare up to five homes side by side. Every result shows the home's neighbourhood, its own check-in time, deposit, pet policy and house rules, and its 4- and 5-star guest reviews from Airbnb and Booking.com, each labelled with its source. Prices are the manager's own, with no online travel agency commission added. The plugin never books for you: when you have chosen a stay it gives you a link to finish checkout, pay by card or Link, and accept the rental terms on Luxury Lodging's own site.
payload.longDescription:
EscapeStays是Luxury Lodging的直接预订网站，该公司是美国拥有约250处度假别墅的专业物业管理人员。
通过地点、日期、人数、卧室数量、宠物和设施搜索房源；查看实时可预订状态；获取已包含清洁费、服务费和税费的最终住宿价格；最多可并排对比五处房源。
每个搜索结果都会显示房源所在社区、独立入住时间、押金政策、宠物规定和房屋规则，并展示来自Airbnb和Booking.com的4星和5星客人评价，每条评价均标注来源。
价格由管理方制定，不包含任何在线旅行社的佣金。
插件不会代您完成预订：当您选定住宿后，会为您提供跳转链接，在Luxury Lodging官网完成支付、信用卡或Link付款，并确认租赁条款。

payload.name: Koko
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Koko turns travel ideas into organized, mappable trips. Plan somewhere to go in chat, then save it straight to your Koko account: a ranked list of places, or a day-by-day itinerary with timed stops. Koko pins every place on a map, fills in ratings, opening hours and photos, and gives you a private link you can open and keep editing on the web or in the Koko app. Ask ChatGPT what you have saved, open a list to change it, or check when a new one is ready.
payload.longDescription: Koko将旅行构思转化为可规划、可地图化的行程。在聊天中规划目的地，然后直接保存到您的Koko账户：一份按排名列出的地点列表，或包含定时停留的每日行程。Koko会在地图上标记每个地点，补充评分、营业时间和照片，并提供一个私有链接，您可以在网页或Koko应用中打开并持续编辑。向ChatGPT询问您保存的内容，打开列表进行修改，或查看是否有新清单准备就绪。

payload.name: Hostizzy Villas & Farmstays
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Hostizzy operates villas, farmhouses, cottages and homestays across India and rents them directly — it isn't a marketplace, so one company is responsible for the price, the property and the stay.

Search 39 homes by destination, party size and budget, check real availability, and get exact all-in totals from the same quote engine the checkout uses. Every price includes GST and the booking fee. There is no cleaning fee, no service fee and no pet fee.

Strongest around Delhi NCR — Gurugram, Sohna, Manesar, Mangar — and in the hills at Mussoorie, Mukteshwar, Shimla and Barog. Read-only: it can research and quote, but never books or takes payment.
payload.longDescription:
Hostizzy在印度各地运营别墅、农舍、小屋和民宿并直接出租——它并非一个市场平台，因此单一公司对价格、房源和住宿体验全权负责。

通过目的地、人数和预算搜索39处房源，查看实时可订状态，并通过与结账系统相同的报价引擎获取精确的全包总价。
所有价格均包含商品及服务税（GST）和预订服务费。
不收取清洁费、服务费或宠物费。

德里国家首都辖区（NCR）周边最强——古尔冈、索纳、马内萨尔、芒加尔，以及穆索里、穆克特斯赫瓦尔、西姆拉和巴罗格的山间地区。
仅限只读模式：可进行研究和报价，但无法完成预订或收取费用。

payload.name: ParkMobile
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ParkMobile helps users find nearby parking, compare estimated prices and walking distances, inspect area details and amenities, and discover parking options for upcoming events.
payload.longDescription: ParkMobile帮助用户查找附近停车位，比较预估价格和步行距离，查看区域详情及配套设施，并发现即将举行的活动的停车选项。

payload.name: OpenVan Travel Data
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Access practical travel data for road trips and vanlife worldwide, including fuel prices, currency exchange rates, cost of living, visa rules, vehicle license plates, events, and travel news. Use current country-level information to compare destinations and prepare informed journeys.
payload.longDescription: 获取全球公路旅行和房车生活的实用旅行数据，包括燃油价格、汇率、生活成本、签证规则、车辆牌照、活动及旅行新闻。利用最新的各国信息比较目的地，制定明智的旅行计划。

payload.name: Flight Gate
payload.description: 航班状态和登机口警报
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Track your flight and get the latest available information about its status, terminal, boarding gate, delays, and gate changes.

Enter your flight number and travel date to check the latest flight information. Flight Gate helps travelers keep important airport information together in ChatGPT before and during their journey.

Flight information can change at any time. Always confirm final boarding and gate information with the airline and airport.
payload.longDescription:
跟踪您的航班并获取有关其状态、航站楼、登机口、延误和登机口变更的最新信息。

输入航班号和出行日期以查看最新航班信息。
Flight Gate帮助旅行者在旅程前后通过ChatGPT集中管理重要的机场信息。

航班信息可能随时变更。
请始终通过航空公司和机场确认最终的登机口信息。

payload.name: Fare Deals
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Cheap flights from any city, to one place or anywhere, with the cheapest days to fly. Fares are the cheapest Aviasales travellers found in the last 48 hours. The live price is on the booking page. Booking links are affiliate links (disclosure field). Prices are in the shopper's currency (currency field); US dollars unless another country is given. Every tool is read-only: no sign-in and nothing about the user is stored. There are no ads or paid placements. Built by Good Turn Studio. More at https://faredeals.pages.dev
payload.longDescription:
从任何城市出发，前往一个地点或任意目的地的低价机票，包含最便宜的出行日期。
票价为Aviasales旅行者过去48小时内找到的最低价格。
实时价格显示在预订页面。
预订链接为联盟链接（披露字段）。
价格以购物者所在货币显示（货币字段）；除非指定其他国家，否则默认为美元。
所有工具均为只读模式：无需登录，且不存储任何用户信息。
无广告或付费推广位置。
由Good Turn Studio开发。
更多信息请访问 https://faredeals.pages.dev

payload.name: COooL
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
COooL provides real-time public transport information across France. It helps users find stops and routes, check upcoming departures, plan journeys, and identify disruptions or incidents affecting public transport services.

Users can interact with COooL directly through ChatGPT to get up-to-date information about their journey, check the status of a transport line, find upcoming departures from a stop, or understand disruptions affecting their route.
payload.longDescription:
COooL为法国提供实时公共交通信息，帮助用户查找站点和路线，查看即将出发的班次，规划行程，并识别影响公共交通服务的中断或事故。

用户可通过ChatGPT直接与COooL互动，获取行程最新信息，查看交通线路状态，查找站点的即将出发班次，或了解影响路线的中断情况。

payload.name: Parky
payload.description: 查看公园等待时间与营业时间
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Plan visits to the Disney and Universal parks supported by Parky. Find parks and rides, check recently observed posted waits and reported operating hours, and explore crowd forecasts with ranges and caveats. Results include source times and links to public Parky pages. Parky is independent of the park operators. This read-only plugin cannot book tickets or access a private Parky Pass.
payload.longDescription: 通过Parky规划参观迪士尼和环球主题公园的行程。查找公园和游乐项目，查看最近记录的等待时间及公布的营业时间，并探索包含范围和注意事项的客流预测。结果会显示来源时间及指向公开Parky页面的链接。Parky与公园运营商无关。此只读插件无法预订门票或访问私人Parky通行证。

payload.name: Déstaire
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Déstaire is a curated guide to exceptional hotels and private stays, with editorial content. Ask for a place, a country or a kind of stay, and get the matching stays (with pricing), the destinations, and the travel articles, each linked to its page on destaire.com. Read-only; no account needed.
payload.longDescription: Déstaire是提供精选奢华酒店和私人住宿的指南，包含编辑内容。输入地点、国家或住宿类型，即可获得匹配的住宿信息（含价格）、目的地和旅行文章，每个条目均链接至destaire.com的对应页面。仅支持只读访问，无需账户。

payload.name: Gangwaze
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Explore cruises with Gangwaze. Search upcoming sailings by destination, dates, cruise line, ship, cabin type and budget; compare selected sailings; and review available fare history and price drops. Look up ships, cabin categories and specific cabins, cruise-line profiles, dress codes, beverage packages, port guides, shore excursions and monthly climate averages. Results include source links and cruise information cards. Prices and coverage depend on available data. Booking, payment, cancellation and reservation changes are not exposed by the current tools.
payload.longDescription: 通过Gangwaze探索邮轮旅行。按目的地、日期、邮轮公司、船只、舱房类型和预算搜索即将启航的航次；对比选定的航次；查看可用的票价历史和价格下跌情况。查询船只信息、舱房类别和具体舱房、邮轮公司简介、着装要求、饮品套餐、港口指南、岸上观光活动及月度气候平均数据。搜索结果包含来源链接和邮轮信息卡。价格和覆盖范围取决于可用数据。当前工具不提供预订、支付、取消和预订变更功能。

payload.name: RESTL – Table Reservations
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: RESTL is the reservation system from St. Pölten built for Austrian hospitality. Search participating venues by place, cuisine and date, see real free time slots and book right in the chat. The booking lands instantly in the venue's system and you receive a confirmation email with a cancellation link. Existing bookings can be looked up or cancelled with the booking code plus the email address used. No account needed. The app never sees guest records or other guests' data; where a venue requires a card guarantee, that step happens only in the browser on restl.at, never in the chat.
payload.longDescription: RESTL是圣珀尔滕开发的奥地利餐饮预订系统。通过地点、菜系和日期搜索参与的场所，查看实时空闲时段并在聊天中直接预订。预订信息会立即同步至餐厅系统，并收到包含取消链接的确认邮件。使用预订码加下单时使用的邮箱可查询或取消已有预订。无需账户。应用不会获取客人信息或其他客人的数据；如餐厅要求信用卡担保，该步骤仅在restl.at的浏览器页面完成，不会在聊天中进行。

payload.name: Spin My Day
payload.description: 在任何城市规划一天外出活动
payload.summaryOriginal: Plan a day out in any city
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Spin up a full day out (morning, lunch, afternoon, dinner, evening) around the weather and what is open, in a city, near a location, or in a random city. Every tool is read-only: no sign-in and nothing about the user is stored. There are no ads or paid placements. Built by Good Turn Studio. More at https://spinmyday.pages.dev
payload.longDescription: 根据天气和开放情况，在城市、附近地点或随机城市中规划完整的外出日（早晨、午餐、下午、晚餐、夜晚）。所有工具均为只读模式：无需注册且不存储任何用户信息。无广告或付费推广。由Good Turn Studio开发。更多信息请访问https://spinmyday.pages.dev

payload.name: ELA Map
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ELA Map draws your birth chart onto the Earth. Every planet sits on four lines around the globe, and astrocartography reads a place by the lines that run near it. Ask ELA Map which cities your lines run through, or whether a place you are considering sits on one, and it answers from your birth date, time and place. The answer is the geography; the reading lives on ELA Map, where all your lines are drawn on an interactive globe with plain-language readings, line crossings and location reports. No account is created inside ChatGPT, and the birth details you give are not stored.
payload.longDescription: ELA Map将您的出生星盘绘制在地球表面。每个行星都位于地球周围的四条线路上，占星地图通过分析附近线路来解读一个地点。您可以询问ELA Map您的星盘线路经过哪些城市，或者您考虑的某个地点是否位于某条线路上，它会根据您的出生日期、时间和地点进行回答。答案呈现为地理信息；解读内容保存在ELA Map中，您可以在交互式地球仪上查看所有线路的自然语言解读、线路交叉点和地点报告。在ChatGPT内部不会创建账户，您提供的出生信息也不会被存储。

DayPass helps you discover and book experiences at premium hotel pools, beach clubs, spas and cabanas worldwide — no overnight stay. Search live experiences by city or country with photos, ratings, prices (incl. child & kid), availability, amenities and guest reviews; each result links to the DayPass booking page. payload.name: 카카오 T 공항가자
payload.description: 找到适合我的机场交通方式
payload.summaryOriginal: 내게 맞는 공항 이동 방법 찾기
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Take the guesswork out of getting to Incheon Airport.

Get personalized recommendations based on your departure point, flight schedule, who you’re traveling with, how much luggage you’re bringing, and what matters most for your trip, including when to leave and which transportation option best fits your needs.

Compare airport buses, trains, taxis, Venti, and driving options, and see why each option is recommended. Depending on the option you choose, you can check the latest airport bus information through the linked operator’s website or book or request a taxi or Venti through Kakao T. If you’re driving to the airport, you can also check Incheon Airport parking information and book valet parking if needed.

Note: Information may include AI-generated content and may differ from actual conditions due to traffic, schedules, parking availability, or service changes. Please check the latest airport bus information on the linked operator’s website, confirm taxi or Venti availability, and check the latest parking information before use.
payload.longDescription:
消除前往仁川机场的不确定性。

根据您的出发地点、航班时间、同行人员、行李数量以及旅行中最重要因素（如出发时间及最适合您的交通方式）提供个性化推荐。

比较机场巴士、火车、出租车、Venti及自驾选项，了解每种方案的推荐理由。
根据所选方案，可通过链接的运营商网站查看最新机场巴士信息，或通过Kakao T预订/请求出租车/Venti。
如自驾前往机场，还可查看仁川机场停车信息并在需要时预订代客泊车服务。

注意：信息可能包含AI生成内容，由于交通状况、时刻表、停车位或服务变更，可能与实际情况不同。
请通过链接的运营商网站查看最新机场巴士信息，确认出租车/Venti可用性，并在使用前查看最新停车信息。

payload.name: Hotely
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Hotely lets you search hotels worldwide right inside ChatGPT. Ask for a destination, dates and guests and get live, priced results with ratings, amenities and photos, then open full hotel details with every available room and rate. Booking is completed securely on hotely.travel via the Book on Hotely link. Read-only: the plugin never books, charges or changes reservations.
payload.longDescription: Hotely可让您直接在ChatGPT内搜索全球酒店。输入目的地、日期和人数即可获得实时定价结果，包含评分、设施和照片信息，可查看所有可选房型及价格详情。预订可通过hotely.travel网站上的「在Hotely预订」链接安全完成。该插件为只读模式，不会执行预订、收费或修改预订操作。

payload.name: Baolau
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Baolau facilitates online booking for train tickets in Asia — Vietnam, Thailand, Cambodia, Laos, Malaysia, China and Japan — and also bus, ferry and flight tickets in Southeast Asia.

This plugin brings Baolau’s search and compare capabilities into ChatGPT to support travel discovery and trip planning.

Travelers can ask ChatGPT how to get between two cities and receive a clear overview of the departures Baolau sells by train, bus, ferry and flight. ChatGPT can compare them by journey duration, departure time, operator, fare class and price, helping travelers choose the option that best suits their budget, schedule and travel needs. ChatGPT can also check a chosen departure live with the operator.

When travelers are ready to book, ChatGPT can direct them to baolau.com with their departure and fare already selected, so they can complete the ticket reservation.

Baolau is an official ticket agent of Vietnam Railways and Royal Railway in Cambodia, and sells tickets for State Railway of Thailand, Laos–China Railway, KTM in Malaysia, China Railway and JR in Japan.
payload.longDescription:
Baolau为亚洲多国火车票提供在线预订服务，涵盖越南、泰国、柬埔寨、老挝、马来西亚、中国和日本，同时销售东南亚地区巴士、渡轮和航班票务。

该插件将Baolau的搜索与比价功能引入ChatGPT，助力旅行探索与行程规划。

旅客可向ChatGPT询问两地间交通方式，获取Baolau提供的火车、巴士、渡轮及航班发车信息概览。
ChatGPT可基于行程时长、发车时间、运营方、票价等级和价格进行比对，帮助旅客选择最符合预算、日程和出行需求的选项。
ChatGPT还可实时查询已选发车信息并对接运营方。

当旅客准备预订时，ChatGPT可跳转至baolau.com并预填好选定的发车信息和票价，方便完成票务预订。

Baolau是越南铁路局和柬埔寨皇家铁路的官方票务代理，同时销售泰国国家铁路、老中铁路、马来西亚KTM、中国铁路及日本JR的车票。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search train, bus, ferry and flight departures in Asia, Compare fare classes and prices, Check one departure live with the operator, Get a link to book on baolau.com

payload.name: How Walkable
payload.description: 任意地点的步行友好度评分
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
How Walkable rates how walkable any address, neighbourhood or city on Earth is, from 0 (car-dependent) to 100 (daily errands need no car).

Ask about a place and get its score, what it means, and the nearest groceries, restaurants, shops, cafés, banks, parks, schools, libraries and venues, each with its walking time. Compare places by asking about several at once, which helps when choosing where to live, work or stay. For about 250 large cities, it also gives each city's world and national rank, and it can list the most or least walkable large cities worldwide or in a country.

Scores are calculated from open map data (Overture Maps and OpenStreetMap): everyday places within a walk earn points that fall with distance, and sparse street networks lose up to 20%. The full method is at howwalkable.com/methodology.

Limitations: scores are estimates from map data, which can be incomplete, so places where shops are poorly mapped score too low. Walking distance is estimated from street density rather than routed, and the score does not consider hills, sidewalks, safety or transit. Mainland China is not covered for city rankings. The app needs no account, and it rates only the place names ChatGPT sends it; it does not use your location.
payload.longDescription:
How Walkable通过0（依赖汽车）到100（日常事务无需汽车）的评分体系，评估地球任意地址、社区或城市的步行友好度。

询问某个地点即可获取其评分、具体含义，以及最近的杂货店、餐厅、商店、咖啡馆、银行、公园、学校、图书馆和场所的步行时间。
同时询问多个地点可进行对比，这在选择居住、工作或停留地点时非常有帮助。
对于约250个大城市，还会提供该城市的全球和国内排名，并可列出全球或特定国家中最宜居或最不宜居的大城市。

评分基于开放地图数据（Overture Maps和OpenStreetMap）：步行可达的日常场所会获得分数，但分数会随距离递减，而道路网络稀疏的区域会减少最多20%的分数。
完整方法论请访问howwalkable.com/methodology。

局限性：评分基于地图数据估算，可能存在信息不全的情况，因此商铺标注不完善的区域评分可能偏低。
步行距离是通过道路密度估算而非实际路径计算，且评分不考虑坡度、人行道、安全性或公共交通。
中国大陆地区不参与城市排名。
该应用无需账户，仅评估ChatGPT发送的地点名称；不会使用您的位置信息。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Score the walkability of any address, neighbourhood or city, Rank large cities by walkability, worldwide or by country

payload.name: PlaneWX
payload.description: 飞行员的航空天气服务
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
PlaneWX brings your aviation weather briefings into ChatGPT. Ask about a route and PlaneWX runs a full briefing against your aircraft and personal minimums, then returns a WX Score with clear reasons: ceilings, visibility, winds and crosswind, en route hazards, NOTAMs, TFRs, density altitude, and daylight.

What you can do:
- Find the best departure windows for a route on a given day, with optional limits like arrive before sunset or a tighter crosswind.
- Score a specific departure time for VFR or IFR.
- Review the stored briefing for any saved trip, including NOTAM summaries and your latest FRAT.
- Save a promising departure time as a PlaneWX trip so it keeps getting briefed.
- Check your profile, aircraft, personal minimums, and usage limits.

PlaneWX presents facts and flags gaps. Missing data is never treated as good weather. It is one input to your preflight process, alongside an official weather briefing and your own judgment. You, the pilot in command, make every go or no-go decision.

Requires a PlaneWX account with AI assistant access. Sign in with your PlaneWX account to connect.

The confidence to go. The courage to stay.
payload.longDescription:
PlaneWX将航空天气简报带入ChatGPT。询问航线后，PlaneWX会根据您的飞机性能和个人最低标准进行完整简报，返回包含明确理由的WX评分：云底高度、能见度、风况和侧风、航路危险、NOTAM、TFR、密度高度以及日照情况。

您可以：
- 在指定日期查找航线的最佳起飞时段，可设置可选限制条件如日落前到达或更严格的侧风限制
- 为VFR/IFR飞行评分特定起飞时间
- 查看已保存行程的简报记录，包含NOTAM摘要和最新FRAT报告
- 将有潜力的起飞时间保存为PlaneWX行程以持续获取简报
- 查看个人资料、飞机信息、个人最低标准和使用限制

PlaneWX呈现客观事实并标记数据缺口。
缺失数据从不被视为良好天气。
它只是您飞行前准备流程中的一个参考依据，需结合官方天气简报和您的专业判断。
最终的放行或推迟决策权在于作为机长的您。

需要拥有AI助手访问权限的PlaneWX账户。
使用PlaneWX账户登录即可连接

启程的自信，留下的勇气

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Find departure windows, Score a route and departure time, Read saved trip briefings, Save a departure as a trip, Read personal minimums and aircraft, Check usage limits, Resolve airports by name or code

- 对比阿拉斯加航空、夏威夷航空及30多家全球合作伙伴航空公司的航班。

payload.name: AdvenBook
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AdvenBook turns your outdoor adventures into a premium printed book. Tell ChatGPT about your hikes, trail runs, bike rides or treks — routes, dates, distances, photos and stories — and AdvenBook lays them out automatically: GPS maps of each route, elevation profiles, stats, your photos and your words. You get a price right away and a private link to preview and edit your book, then order it on advenbook.com. Hardcover, softcover or spiral notebook, printed near you and shipped for free.
payload.longDescription: AdvenBook将您的户外冒险转化为一本高端印刷书籍。向ChatGPT描述您的徒步旅行、越野跑、骑行或远足经历——路线、日期、距离、照片和故事，AdvenBook会自动生成：每条路线的GPS地图、海拔剖面图、数据统计、您的照片和文字描述。您将立即获得价格和一个私人链接以预览和编辑书籍，随后可在advenbook.com下单。提供硬壳精装、软皮平装或螺旋装订三种形式，就近印刷并免费配送。

payload.name: Traveler.md
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Traveler.md gives AI assistants and agents a memory for how you actually travel.

All of your travel preferences, saved in one place: how you like to fly, where you like to stay, what you eat, how you pace a trip, who you travel with. All of your trips, saved in one place too, in portable Trip.md files that update as your plans evolve. Each trip now comes with an itinerary, a day-by-day view of your flights, stays, reservations, and plans, so you can see the whole trip at a glance. Instead of re-explaining yourself in every conversation, your assistant loads your travel memory and plans with your preferences already in mind.

What AI assistants and agents can do with Traveler.md:
- Read your preferences so recommendations reflect how you really travel, from the first message
- Update your travel memory when they learn something new about you
- List, read, create, and update your trips, so bookings and plans stay organized as they change
- Add itinerary events like flights, hotel stays, dinner reservations, and activities, building a clear day-by-day plan for every trip

You stay in control. Your Traveler.md belongs to you, not to any single platform. Access uses OAuth with granular scopes, so you approve exactly what can be read or changed, and you can disconnect at any time. Your travel memory stays yours.

Great for:
- Planning trips without repeating your preferences every time
- Seeing your whole trip laid out day by day in one itinerary
- Keeping a running record of trips in progress
- Recommendations that account for your loyalty programs, seat preferences, and travel style
Carrying one travel profile across every tool you plan with

To get started, connect Traveler.md, sign in or create a free account, and authorize access. Your preferences, trips, and itineraries load automatically whenever travel comes up.
payload.longDescription:
Traveler.md让AI助手和代理记住你实际的旅行方式。

所有旅行偏好集中保存：你喜欢的飞行方式、喜欢的住宿地点、饮食习惯、行程节奏以及同行人员。
所有旅行记录也集中保存，以可移植的Trip.md文件形式随计划更新而自动更新。
每段旅行现在都配有行程单，以每日视图展示航班、住宿、预订和计划，让你一目了然掌握整个行程。
无需在每次对话中重复说明自己，你的助手会加载旅行记忆和计划，预先考虑你的偏好。

AI助手和代理可通过Traveler.md实现以下功能：
- 读取你的偏好，使推荐内容从第一句话就符合你真实的旅行方式
- 在了解你的新信息时更新旅行记忆
- 列出、阅读、创建和更新你的旅行记录，确保预订和计划随变化保持有序
- 添加行程事件如航班、酒店住宿、晚餐预订和活动，为每段旅行构建清晰的每日计划

你始终掌握控制权。
你的Traveler.md属于你，而非任何单一平台。
通过OAuth授权访问，可精细控制读取或修改范围，你可以随时取消连接。
你的旅行记忆始终属于你。

适用于：
- 无需反复说明偏好即可规划旅行
- 在行程单中查看每日详细行程安排
- 保存进行中旅行的实时记录
- 根据你的忠诚计划、座位偏好和旅行风格获得个性化推荐
- 在所有旅行规划工具中使用统一的旅行档案

开始使用请连接Traveler.md，登录或创建免费账户并授权访问。
当涉及旅行相关事项时，你的偏好、行程和行程单会自动加载。

payload.name: Flatovo
payload.description: 寻找贝尔格莱德的租房信息
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find long-term apartments for rent in Belgrade. Search public listings with detailed filters, explore them on a map, browse photos, and compare up to three apartments side by side.

Filter by price, rooms, neighborhood, size, furnishings, floor, renovation, amenities, parking, pet restrictions, listing source, language, and publication date. Open the original listing to contact its author.

The app interface is in English; source listings may be in other languages. Availability and unspecified conditions must be confirmed with the listing author. Flatovo does not process payments, make reservations, or access your private website account. Saved apartments stay within the current local app session.
payload.longDescription:
在贝尔格莱德寻找长期出租公寓。通过详细筛选条件搜索公开列表，通过地图探索房源，浏览照片，并并排比较最多三处公寓。

可按价格、房间数、社区、面积、装修情况、楼层、翻新程度、配套设施、停车条件、宠物限制、房源来源、语言及发布日期进行筛选。点击进入原始房源与发布者联系。

应用界面为英文；房源信息可能包含其他语言。可用性及未明确条款需与房源发布者确认。Flatovo不处理支付、预订或访问您的私人网站账户。已保存的公寓仅在当前本地应用会话中有效。

payload.name: Tourision
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Tourision lets you explore immersive 360-degree virtual tours of real places, such as hotels, real estate, museums, showrooms and venues, right inside the conversation.

Ask for a tour by place name, city or keyword, and Tourision finds matching tours and opens one in an interactive viewer. You can look around by dragging, zoom in and out, and move between the rooms and areas of the place.

What it can do:
- Search publicly published virtual tours by name, address or description.
- Open a tour in an embedded, interactive 360-degree viewer, with a link to open the full tour in a new tab.

Who it is for:
- Travellers checking a hotel before booking.
- People looking at a property, venue or showroom remotely.
- Anyone who wants to see what a place looks like inside before visiting.

Limitations:
- The app is read-only. It cannot create, edit or delete tours.
- Only tours that their owners have published publicly on Tourision are available. Draft and archived tours are never returned.
- No account or sign-in is needed, and the app does not ask for or store any personal information.
payload.longDescription:
Tourision让你在对话中探索真实场所的沉浸式360度虚拟游览，包括酒店、房地产、博物馆、展厅和活动场所。

通过场所名称、城市或关键词请求游览，Tourision会查找匹配的游览内容并在交互式查看器中打开一个游览。你可以通过拖动查看周围环境，放大和缩小，并在场所的不同房间和区域之间移动。

它能够实现的功能：
- 通过名称、地址或描述搜索公开发布的虚拟游览
- 在嵌入式的交互式360度查看器中打开游览，并提供链接可在新标签页中查看完整游览

适用人群：
- 预订前检查酒店的旅行者
- 远程查看房产、场地或展厅的人士
- 想在到访前了解场所内部情况的任何人

使用限制：
- 该应用为只读模式
无法创建、编辑或删除游览
- 仅可访问其所有者在Tourision上公开发布的游览
草稿和存档的游览永远不会被返回
- 不需要账户或登录，应用不会请求或存储任何个人身份信息。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search 360-degree virtual tours, Show an interactive 360-degree tour in chat

payload.name: arso.lol — Slovenian weather
payload.description: 斯洛文尼亚天气（非官方）
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
arso.lol is an independent, unofficial weather service — not ARSO (the Slovenian Environment Agency) and not affiliated with it. It brings ARSO's public weather station network into ChatGPT — the same data as arso.lol, refreshed every 10 minutes. Ask "will it rain in Bled tomorrow?", "how windy is it on Kredarica?" or "where is it warmest in Slovenia right now?" and ChatGPT finds the right station and reads the latest measurement or forecast.

- Find weather stations by name, region (including traditional names such as Primorska or Štajerska) or nearest to a location — towns without their own station get the nearest ones with distances
- Current weather at a station: temperature, feels-like, wind, humidity, precipitation and condition, with the measurement time, sunrise, sunset and a 24-hour rain outlook
- Hourly forecast for up to 72 hours and a daily outlook for up to 11 days
- Rank stations across Slovenia or one region by temperature or wind, or show where it is raining now

Every result links to the station's page on arso.lol. Read-only, no account needed. Works in English and Slovenian.

Limitations: covers Slovenia only — no official weather warnings and no historical climate data. arso.lol is unofficial and not affiliated with ARSO.
payload.longDescription:
arso.lol是一个独立的非官方天气服务，与斯洛文尼亚环境局（ARSO）无关联且未获其授权。该服务将ARSO的公共气象站网络接入ChatGPT——使用与arso.lol相同的实时数据，每10分钟更新一次。您可询问「明天布莱德会下雨吗？」、「克雷达里卡现在风大吗？」或「现在斯洛文尼亚哪个地方最温暖？」，ChatGPT会自动定位对应气象站并读取最新观测数据或预报。

- 通过名称、地区（含传统名称如滨海地区或施蒂里亚）或最近位置查找气象站——无独立气象站的城镇将显示最近的站点及距离
- 显示气象站当前天气：温度、体感温度、风速、湿度、降水量及天气状况，包含观测时间、日出日落时间以及24小时降雨预报
- 提供最多72小时的逐小时预报和最多11天的每日展望
- 按温度或风速对斯洛文尼亚全国或单个地区气象站进行排名，或实时显示降雨区域

每个结果均链接至arso.lol网站的气象站页面。
只读模式，无需账户。
支持英语和斯洛文尼亚语。

限制条件：仅覆盖斯洛文尼亚地区——不提供官方天气预警及历史气候数据。arso.lol为非官方服务，与ARSO无关联。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Find Slovenian weather stations by name, region or location, Current weather at a station, Hourly and 11-day forecasts, Compare weather across Slovenia

payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Planifica y compara viajes en Despegar: busca vuelos, hoteles, actividades y seguros, navega los resultados en carruseles y continúa al checkout en Despegar. Las herramientas funcionan sin interfaz; los widgets aparecen cuando el host soporta MCP Apps.

payload.name: Aisle
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find destination wedding venues and vendors, compare guest capacity and costs, and plan what happens next. Aisle brings its venue directory, planning guides, budget estimates, travel estimates, and wedding tools into your conversation. Cost estimates are planning figures, not supplier quotes or live availability.

Connect your Aisle account to view your wedding details, guests, RSVP counts, events, accommodations, and registry. Add or update guests and events, manage accommodations, and change wedding details for the wedding you select. Individual guest tools are available only for guests explicitly confirmed as 13 or older. Guests under 13 or with unconfirmed ages are managed in Aisle; everyone remains included in RSVP totals. Guest notes and dietary details are not shared through ChatGPT. Changes follow the permissions and membership access of your existing Aisle account.

Public discovery and planning tools work without signing in. Wedding management requires an Aisle account. Aisle does not book venues, sell subscriptions, or collect payments through this plugin.
payload.longDescription:
查找目的地婚礼场地和供应商，对比宾客容量和成本，并规划后续事宜。Aisle将场地目录、规划指南、预算估算、差旅估算和婚礼工具整合到您的对话中。成本估算仅为规划数据，非供应商报价或实时可用性。

连接您的Aisle账户可查看婚礼详情、宾客信息、回复人数、活动安排、住宿和礼品清单。可添加或更新宾客信息和活动，管理住宿安排，并修改所选婚礼的细节。仅对明确确认年龄为13岁及以上的宾客提供个别客人工具。未满13岁或未确认年龄的宾客由Aisle管理；所有宾客仍计入回复总数。宾客备注和饮食需求详情不会通过ChatGPT共享。修改操作遵循您现有Aisle账户的权限和会员访问级别。

公共发现和规划工具无需登录即可使用。婚礼管理需要Aisle账户。Aisle不通过此插件预订场地、销售订阅服务或收取付款。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Find wedding venues and vendors, Estimate wedding budgets and guest travel costs, Use wedding planning guides and tools, View wedding details and RSVP counts, Manage guests, events, and accommodations, View registry progress

payload.longDescriptionOriginal: e-eSIM helps travelers find prepaid mobile-data eSIM plans by destination, compare plan specifications and prices, view detailed coverage and plan information, and continue to secure checkout on the e-eSIM shop.

payload.name: poste — Slovenian post offices
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
poste is an independent, unofficial service by poste.cc — not Pošta Slovenije and not affiliated with it. It brings Pošta Slovenije's post offices, parcel lockers (paketomati) and street mailboxes into ChatGPT — the same data as poste.cc. Ask "is the post office in Koper open now?" or "which post offices in 1000 Ljubljana are open on Saturday?" and ChatGPT finds the branches and reads their opening hours with Slovenian public holidays applied.

- Search post offices, parcel lockers and mailboxes by place, postal code, branch code, address or nickname
- Find the nearest post offices, parcel lockers and mailboxes to a location, with distance
- Get one post office's hours for the next 7 days, whether it is open now, on-duty and mobile post office schedules, services, phone numbers and nearby alternatives

Every result links to the full page on poste.cc. Read-only, no account needed. Works in English and Slovenian.

Limitations: covers Pošta Slovenije in Slovenia only — no parcel tracking, postage prices or mailbox collection times. poste.cc is unofficial and not affiliated with Pošta Slovenije.
payload.longDescription:
poste是一个独立的非官方服务，由poste.cc提供——与斯洛文尼亚邮政（Pošta Slovenije）无关，也未与其关联。该服务将斯洛文尼亚邮政的邮局、包裹柜（paketomati）和街头邮箱整合至ChatGPT——数据与poste.cc完全一致。您可询问「科佩尔的邮局现在开门吗？」或「1000卢布尔雅那哪些邮局周六营业？」，ChatGPT将查找对应网点并读取其营业时间（已考虑斯洛文尼亚公共假期）

- 按地点、邮政编码、分支代码、地址或昵称搜索邮局、包裹柜（paketomati）和街头邮箱
- 查找距离当前位置最近的邮局、包裹柜和邮箱（附距离信息）
- 获取某家邮局未来7天的营业时间、当前是否营业、值班安排及移动邮局时刻表、服务内容、电话号码和周边替代网点

每个搜索结果均链接至poste.cc的完整页面
只读模式，无需账户
支持英语和斯洛文尼亚语

限制说明：仅覆盖斯洛文尼亚境内的斯洛文尼亚邮政——不提供包裹追踪、邮费价格或邮箱取件时间。poste.cc为非官方平台，与斯洛文尼亚邮政无关联

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search Slovenian post offices, parcel lockers and mailboxes, Nearest post offices, parcel lockers and mailboxes, Post office opening hours and details

payload.name: Camper Champ
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Camper Champ compares campervan and motorhome hire from rental companies around the world. Tell it where you want to pick up and drop off, and your dates, and it shows the vans available for your trip as cards: photo, rental company and rating, how many people it seats and sleeps, transmission, toilet and shower, and cancellation and confirmation details.

It covers one-way and return trips in Australia, New Zealand, the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom and Ireland, Iceland, most of Europe, Japan, southern Africa and more: over 600 pick-up cities and airports in 47 countries. Ask about one van for its depot address and opening hours, minimum driver age, beds, water tanks and rental terms.

Book takes you to camperchamp.com with your van selected, where you can compare it with the others and continue your booking there. Camper Champ only looks up availability: it never books, pays or changes anything in ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription:
Camper Champ会对比全球租车公司提供的露营车和房车租赁服务。输入您想取车和还车的地点以及日期，它会以卡片形式展示适合您行程的露营车信息，包含照片、租赁公司、评分、可容纳人数、传动类型、卫生间和淋浴设施，以及取消和确认详情。

服务覆盖澳大利亚、新西兰、美国、加拿大、英国及爱尔兰、冰岛、欧洲大部分地区、日本、南非等地的单程和往返行程，支持47个国家的600多个城市和机场。您可以查询某辆露营车的仓库地址和营业时间、最低驾驶年龄、床位配置、水箱容量和租赁条款。

预订功能会将您引导至camperchamp.com，您可在此对比其他车型并继续完成预订流程。Camper Champ仅用于查询车辆可用性，不会在ChatGPT中进行预订、支付或修改任何信息。

payload.name: FishFriender
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: FishFriender is a companion for anglers, supporting recreational and sport fishing as well as fishing outings and trips. Explore your catches, fishing sessions, records, statistics and tackle box to understand your fishing history and prepare your next outing. Find fishing spots, rivers and lakes, compare weather, tides and solunar conditions, and choose tackle for your target species. Connect your own FishFriender account through OAuth. A FishFriender SCALE account is required for data tools; sending feedback remains available without a SCALE account. The integration cannot create, edit or delete catches.
payload.longDescription:
FishFriender是为垂钓者打造的伴侣应用，支持休闲垂钓和竞技钓鱼，以及各类垂钓活动和旅行。
探索您的渔获记录、垂钓时段、统计数据和钓具箱，了解您的垂钓历史并为下一次活动做准备。
查找垂钓地点、河流和湖泊，比较天气、潮汐和月相条件，为您的目标鱼种选择合适钓具。
通过OAuth连接您的FishFriender账户。
使用数据工具需要FishFriender SCALE账户；未注册SCALE账户也可发送反馈。
该集成无法创建、编辑或删除渔获。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Explore catches, Analyze fishing statistics, Plan fishing trips, Browse tackle box, Send feedback when requested

payload.name: RouteXK
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
RouteXK plans multi-stop routes for drivers, couriers, sales reps and anyone running errands. List a starting point and the places you need to visit in any order; RouteXK finds the most efficient order and shows it in the chat with the total distance and the estimated time including stops.

What you can do:
- Optimize up to 25 stops in one route, starting anywhere and ending at a chosen place, at the last stop, or back at the start.
- Use full addresses or place names; add a city if the addresses are short.
- Open the planned route on the RouteXK website or in the RouteXK mobile app without typing the stops again, to navigate it turn by turn.

Limitations: routes are planned for driving. Addresses that cannot be found are listed back so you can clarify them. Time windows, vehicle capacity and multi-driver routes are not available in ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription:
RouteXK为司机、快递员、销售代表以及需要跑腿的人士规划多站点路线。输入起点和需要访问的地点（顺序不限）；RouteXK会找出最优路径，在聊天界面中展示总距离和包含停靠时间的预估时长。

可实现的功能：
- 单条路线最多优化25个站点，可从任意位置出发，最终停靠在指定地点、最后一个站点或返回起点
- 支持完整地址或地名输入；地址信息简略时可补充城市信息
- 无需重新输入站点即可在RouteXK官网或移动应用查看规划路线，实现逐步导航

使用限制：仅支持驾车路线规划。
无法识别的地址会返回列表供您确认。
ChatGPT中不支持时间窗口、车辆容量及多司机路线功能。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Plan optimized multi-stop driving routes, Show stop order, distance and drive time, Open the route on the web or in the mobile app

payload.name: Haulest
payload.description: 规划搬家并评估搬家公司
payload.summaryOriginal: Plan a move and vet movers
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Haulest helps people in the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom plan a home move.

Ask for a research cost range by home size and distance, see which movers near a place have dated, attributed reviews, open one company's profile with its licence identifiers and the live FMCSA authority record, look a USDOT or MC number up before paying a deposit, read the guides on binding versus non-binding estimates, deposits, damage claims, and timing, and pull a moving checklist. When you are ready, Haulest can take a quote request so licensed movers call and email you with written estimates; you decide, and your consent is asked for first.

Haulest is a consumer research and quote site run by Panaweb LLC. It is not a carrier, does not operate trucks, and its cost figures are planning ranges compiled from published industry tables and public quotes, never bids. Ratings are the mean of real, dated reviews on record.
payload.longDescription:
Haulest帮助美国、加拿大和英国的人们规划家庭搬家。

根据房屋大小和距离询问研究成本范围，查看所在地区搬家公司的真实评价，通过许可证编号查看单个公司的资料及实时FMCSA授权记录，支付定金前查询USDOT或MC编号，阅读关于约束性与非约束性报价、定金、损坏索赔和时间安排的指南，并获取搬家清单。准备就绪后，Haulest可代为发起报价请求，持证搬家公司会通过电话和邮件提供书面报价；您将做出决定，且首先会征求您的同意。

Haulest是由Panaweb LLC运营的消费者研究和报价网站。它不是承运商，不运营卡车，其成本数据是根据公开行业表格和公共报价汇编的规划范围，从不是投标。评分是记录在案的真实、带日期的评分的平均值。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Research cost range for a move by home size and distance (US, CA, UK), Route facts: driving miles and hours, cost ranges, migration flows, Reviewed movers near a city, state, province, or country, One company's profile: rating, newest reviews, licence record, phone, USDOT, MC, or Companies House licence lookup with the official record, Guides on estimates, deposits, claims, timing, and consumer rights, Moving checklists: 8-week, moving day, first night, change of address, Quote request to licensed movers, with explicit consent

payload.name: PK Spot

payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Discover public parkour Spots, upcoming events and local community information from PK Spot. Search by place or name, compare listed amenities, and open source links for more details. No PK Spot account is required. Results are a bounded selection, not a complete directory. Listings do not guarantee safety, access permission, opening hours or suitability for a particular skill level. The integration cannot create content, book events or export the database.
payload.longDescription: 从PK Spot发现公共攀岩地点、即将举行的活动和本地社区信息。通过地点或名称搜索、比较列出的设施，并查看开源链接以获取更多详情。无需PK Spot账户。结果为有限筛选，而非完整目录。名录不保证安全性、访问权限、营业时间或特定技能水平的适用性。该集成无法创建内容、预订活动或导出数据库。

payload.name: DoYouItaly
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
DoYouItaly lets you research a car rental without leaving the conversation.

Give a destination and your dates, and you get a real availability search: the
cheapest car for those dates, with its transmission, number of seats, fuel
policy, mileage, cancellation terms and deposit, plus a direct link to the full
listing.

It also turns a place name into the right DoYouItaly page — airport, train
station or city location — and answers questions about the rental process from
the official help centre, with a link to the source of every answer.

Prices are real at the moment of the search and can change afterwards, so they
are always shown with a link to the page. Bookings are completed on
doyouitaly.com. No account, sign-in or personal data is needed to use it.
payload.longDescription:
DoYouItaly让你无需离开对话界面即可研究租车信息。

输入目的地和日期，即可获得实时可用性搜索结果：包含变速箱类型、座位数、燃油政策、里程限制、取消条款和押金信息的最便宜车型，并附带直达完整列表的链接。

它还能将机场、火车站或城市位置等地点名称自动匹配到正确的DoYouItaly页面，并从官方帮助中心解答租车流程相关问题，每个答案都附有来源链接。

搜索时显示的价格为实时报价，后续可能发生变化，因此所有价格均附带对应页面链接。
预订需在doyouitaly.com完成。
使用时无需账户、登录或提供个人资料。

payload.name: Cerca.me
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Keep your place memory with you when you plan a trip or decide where to go. Connect your Cerca account to use your want-to-go places, loved and liked places, taste profile, and recommendations from people whose places you are allowed to see. Compare your places with a friend, recall past favorites, and find details for places already known to Cerca. When you ask, save a place for later, rate somewhere you visited, update notes, remove your own places, import up to 25 places at once, or start an import from a shared Google Maps list and check its progress. Cerca distinguishes friends' recommendations from its own editorial picks. Want-to-go notes are private; rating notes are public on your profile. Rating a saved place moves it out of want-to-go. Search covers Cerca's catalogue; Google place lookups help resolve saves and ratings and may enrich details, subject to daily limits. Your assistant creates recommendations from returned data. A Cerca account and OAuth authorization are required; write actions require write access. You can revoke connections in Settings → AI assistants. Reservations, bookings, payments, private Google account access, and continuous Google Maps synchronization are unsupported.
payload.longDescription:
在规划旅行或决定去哪时，随时记住你的地点。

payload.name: OlaChill Travel
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
OlaChill (MIA Co., Ltd., Osaka, Japan) sells travel products in Japan: guided and private day tours, local experiences and activities, attraction and transport tickets, helicopter sightseeing flights, private airport transfers with a driver, and charter coaches and minibuses for groups. It also prepares charter coach estimates for group trips in Schengen-area countries in Europe.

With OlaChill Travel you can:
- Get a shortlist of OlaChill tours, activities, tickets or ryokan matched to a traveller's area, interests and practical preferences, with explicit match reasons and caveats.
- Search OlaChill's Japan tours, activities, cultural experiences and tickets by keyword, city and type, with a 'from' price in yen and a link to each product page.
- Check which dates are open for a Japan tour or a ticket before you book.
- Find ryokan (traditional Japanese inns) selected by OlaChill by area, private onsen, meals and budget, with a dated reference price; OlaChill then checks availability and the current price with the inn when you send a request on the ryokan's page.
- Find helicopter flights over Tokyo, Yokohama, Mt Fuji, Osaka and Kyoto, including whether seats are sold one by one or only as the whole aircraft.
- Compare fixed prices for private airport and resort transfers for up to six passengers.
- Match a group to the right coach, minibus or van, get a price estimate and, only when you ask, send a charter quotation request to OlaChill.
- Find golf rounds at courses near Tokyo, Mt Fuji and Kansai, and golf trips with transport.
- Compare chauffeured cars (Alphard, Lexus, Mercedes and more) by the day or by the hour.
- Find Japan eSIM data plans for a trip or a longer stay.
- Check the status of an existing OlaChill booking or request with its reference and the email used to book.

How booking works: prices are 'from' prices or estimates. Dates, the final price, cancellation terms and payment are completed by you on olachill.com. A charter quotation request is not a booking and does not charge you; OlaChill replies by email after checking vehicle availability.

Coverage and limits: products are in Japan, except charter coach estimates for supported Schengen countries. This app does not book flights or hotels, does not make restaurant reservations, does not show rail timetables and does not give general travel advice. Availability and prices change; the product page on olachill.com is the reference.
payload.longDescription:
OlaChill（MIA Co., Ltd.，日本大阪）在日本销售旅游产品，包括导游和私人一日游、当地体验活动、景点及交通票务、直升机观光飞行、带司机的私人机场接送，以及面向团体的包车和小型巴士服务。该公司还为欧洲申根区国家的团体旅行提供包车报价。

通过OlaChill Travel您可以：
- 根据旅行者的区域、兴趣和实际偏好，获取与OlaChill旅游产品、活动、票务或日式旅馆匹配的短名单，包含明确的匹配理由和注意事项。
- 通过关键词、城市和类型搜索OlaChill的日本旅游产品、活动、文化体验和票务，显示日元起价和每件产品的页面链接。
- 在预订前查看日本旅游产品或票务的可预订日期。
- 按区域、私人温泉、餐饮和预算筛选OlaChill精选的日式旅馆，显示带日期的参考价格；OlaChill在您点击旅馆页面申请时会核实住宿可用性及当前价格。
- 查找东京、横滨、富士山、大阪和京都的直升机飞行服务，显示座位是单独销售还是整机销售。
- 比较最多六人乘坐的私人机场和度假村接送的固定价格。
- 为团队匹配合适的巴士、小型巴士或面包车，获取价格估算，并在您提出请求时向OlaChill发送包车报价申请。
- 查找东京、富士山和关西附近球场的高尔夫球场次，以及包含交通的高尔夫旅行套餐。
- 按天或按小时比较豪华轿车（Alphard、雷克萨斯、奔驰等）价格。
- 查找适用于旅行或长期停留的日本eSIM数据套餐。
- 通过预订编号和预订时使用的邮箱查询现有OlaChill订单或申请的状态。

预订流程：价格为「起价」或估算价。
日期、最终价格、取消条款和支付方式需在olachill.com上由您完成。
包车报价申请不是预订，不会产生费用；OlaChill在核实车辆可用性后通过邮件回复。

覆盖范围与限制：产品仅限日本地区，除支持的申根区国家包车报价外。
本应用不预订航班或酒店，不提供餐厅预订、不显示铁路时刻表，也不提供一般旅行建议。
可用性和价格可能变动；olachill.com上的产品页面为最终依据。

payload.name: TripWays
payload.description: 提供实时团体价格的旅游服务
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
TripWays connects ChatGPT to a live catalog of about 16,000 tours, day trips, and activities in 120 countries, from food walks in Rome to island trips from Phuket.

Ask in plain words. ChatGPT can search by place, budget, duration, activity, and cancellation policy; read a tour's itinerary, inclusions, meeting point, and cancellation terms; check the operator's live calendar for open start times and seats; and price your group (adults, children, seniors) for a chosen date and time.

When you are ready, it gives you a TripWays checkout link with your date, time, and travelers filled in. You pay on tripways.com in your browser. Nothing is purchased inside ChatGPT: the app never holds a seat, creates a cart, or takes card details, and it does not ask for your name, email, or location.

Prices are in USD and come from the operator's booking calendar at the moment you ask. No account or login is needed.
payload.longDescription:
TripWays将ChatGPT连接到包含约16,000个旅游项目、一日游和活动的实时目录，覆盖120个国家，从罗马的美食漫步到普吉岛的岛屿之旅

用自然语言提问。
ChatGPT可根据地点、预算、时长、活动类型和取消政策进行搜索；查看旅游行程、包含项目、集合地点和取消条款；查看运营商实时日历中的可选出发时间和剩余座位；为选定日期和时间的团体（成人、儿童、老人）计算价格

准备就绪后，会生成包含日期、时间和旅行者的TripWays结账链接。
您可在tripways.com网站的浏览器中完成支付。
在ChatGPT内部不会进行任何购买操作：该应用不会预留座位、创建购物车或获取信用卡信息，也不会要求提供姓名、邮箱或位置信息

价格以美元计价，来源于您询问时运营商预订日历的实时数据。
无需账户或登录

payload.name: Trvlrr
payload.description: 每一次旅行，过去和未来的

Ask questions about your travels.

Connect your Trvlrr account to access every trip you've taken and the ones you're planning, including flights, trains, stays, activities, photos and travel stats.

The assistant uses this to answer questions, file new bookings on the right trip, and help plan what's next.

- Where are we staying in Kyoto, and when do we fly home?
- Add this hotel confirmation to my trip
- Find my photo of the Rialto Bridge

Trvlrr is a private travel journal for iPhone and the web. Photo search and packing lists are part of Trvlrr Plus. https://trvlrr.app
payload.longDescription:
向助手提问关于你的旅行的问题。

将你的Trvlrr账户连接起来，即可访问你曾去过的所有旅行和计划中的旅行，包括航班、火车、住宿、活动、照片和旅行数据。

示例问题：
- 我曾经去过哪些国家？

Trvlrr是专为iPhone和网页端设计的私人旅行日记。
照片搜索和打包清单是Trvlrr Plus的功能。 https://trvlrr.app

payload.name: DoYouSpain
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
DoYouSpain lets you research a car rental without leaving the conversation.

Give a destination and your dates, and you get a real availability search: the cheapest car for those dates, with its transmission, number of seats, fuel policy, mileage, cancellation terms and deposit, plus a direct link to the full listing.

It also turns a place name into the right DoYouSpain page — airport, train station or city location — and answers questions about the rental process from the official help centre, with a link to the source of every answer.

Prices are real at the moment of the search and can change afterwards, so they are always shown with a link to the page. Bookings are completed on doyouspain.com. No account, sign-in or personal data is needed to use it.
payload.longDescription:
DoYouSpain让您无需离开对话即可研究租车信息。

输入目的地和日期后，您将获得实时可用性搜索结果：该日期最便宜的汽车，包含变速箱类型、座位数、燃油政策、里程限制、取消条款和押金信息，并附带直接链接到完整列表。

它还能将地点名称转换为对应的DoYouSpain页面——机场、火车站或城市位置——并回答来自官方帮助中心的租车流程问题，每个答案都附带原始信息来源链接。

搜索时价格为实时报价，后续可能变动，因此所有价格均附带页面链接。
预订需在doyouspain.com完成。
使用时无需账户、登录或个人数据。

payload.name: Flying Fine
payload.summaryOriginal: How much is the good seat?
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
You were going to spend $300 on a seat at the back. On that route, on that date, the flat bed might be closer than you think — or far further away. Flying Fine tells you which.

Ask what business or first class costs on any of 1,503 US domestic routes and you get the real range: the cheapest fare recorded, the typical fare, and the high end — drawn from actual tickets sold, published quarterly by the US Department of Transportation. Give it a budget instead and it will show you which routes that money can actually reach, longest trip first.

It also separates lie-flat beds from reclining seats. On some routes the cheapest premium ticket is a recliner while a genuine flat bed costs a few hundred more, and price alone will not tell you which is which.

These are historical figures, not live fares, and the plugin says so every time. Where a route rests on only a few dozen recorded tickets it flags that too, rather than presenting a thin number as a firm one. There is no booking and no checkout — you confirm with the airline.
payload.longDescription:
你原本打算花300美元购买后排座位。
在同一条航线和日期上，平躺床可能比你想象的更近——或者更远。
Flying Fine会告诉你具体是哪种情况。

询问1,503条美国国内航线中任意一条航线的商务舱或头等舱价格，你会获得真实价格区间：记录到的最低票价、平均票价以及高价——数据来源于美国交通部每季度发布的实际售出机票。
输入预算后，它会显示这笔钱能实际覆盖哪些航线，优先展示最长的行程。

它还能区分平躺床和可调节座椅。
某些航线上最便宜的高端票是可调节座椅，而真正的平躺床价格会高出几百美元，仅凭价格无法判断具体类型。

这些是历史数据，而非实时票价，插件每次都会明确说明。
当某条航线仅记录了几十张机票信息时，系统也会特别标注，而非将少量数据呈现为确定性结论。
本插件不提供预订和结账功能——你需要直接向航空公司确认。

payload.name: MTX Connect: eSIM + Travel SIM
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find prepaid travel data for your trip in ChatGPT. Tell MTX Connect where you are going and see live packages with price, data allowance, validity, and the countries each plan covers.

Compare a local plan for one country with a regional plan that works across several destinations. When you have chosen a package, tap Proceed and complete checkout on the MTX Connect website. Payment is not taken inside ChatGPT.

MTX Connect SIM and eSIM cards are reusable: after the first purchase you can add more packages later in your MTX Connect account. A physical SIM is shipped; an eSIM requires a compatible phone. MTX Connect is a Luxembourg-based mobile operator.
payload.longDescription:
在ChatGPT中查找旅行预付费数据。告诉MTX Connect你要去的地方，查看实时套餐，包括价格、数据额度、有效期以及每个计划覆盖的国家。

将单一国家的本地套餐与覆盖多个目的地的区域套餐进行对比。选择套餐后点击继续，在MTX Connect网站完成结账。支付不会在ChatGPT内进行。

MTX Connect SIM卡和eSIM卡可重复使用：首次购买后，您可以在MTX Connect账户中后续添加更多套餐。实体SIM卡会寄送，eSIM需要兼容手机。MTX Connect是一家卢森堡的移动运营商。

payload.name: WINGIE
payload.description: 查找航班、酒店及租车服务
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Plan your trip in one conversation with WINGIE. Tell ChatGPT where and when you want to go, and WINGIE searches live prices for flights, hotels and rental cars so you can compare your options without opening dozens of tabs.

Flights: compare one-way and round-trip fares from more than 300 airlines, with schedules and stops.
Hotels: browse hotels at your destination, then see room types, prices, photos and policies for the one you like.
Rental cars: compare vehicles, prices and rental terms for your pickup and drop-off dates.

Found the right option? WINGIE gives you a link to complete your booking and payment securely on WINGIE, where the final price is confirmed. No sign-in is needed to search. WINGIE is available in 25 languages with prices in local currencies, and our support team is there for you 24/7.
payload.longDescription:
通过与WINGIE的一次对话规划您的行程。告诉ChatGPT您想去哪里以及何时去，WINGIE将为您搜索航班、酒店和租车的实时价格，让您无需打开数十个标签页即可比较所有选项。

航班：比较300多家航空公司的单程和往返票价，包含时刻表和经停信息。酒店：浏览目的地的酒店，查看您喜欢的酒店的房型、价格、照片和政策。租车：比较不同车型、价格和租还车日期的租赁条款。

找到合适的选项了吗？WINGIE将为您提供安全链接，可在WINGIE上完成预订和支付，最终价格已确认。搜索无需登录。WINGIE支持25种语言，价格以当地货币显示，我们的客服团队将为您提供24/7支持。

payload.name: WhatsDo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
WhatsDo turns a conversation about going out into a booking the venue actually receives.

Ask for dinner, a massage, a gym class or somewhere to take a visiting friend, and WhatsDo returns ranked local places with photos, ratings, hours and which of them accept bookings through the app. Where a venue does, the booking is placed in the same conversation. Where it does not, WhatsDo says so and hands over the phone number or the venue's own booking page instead.

What it covers: restaurants, cafes, bars and nightlife, gyms and yoga and other fitness, spas, salons, massage, pet services, hotels, events and activities.

How it books: WhatsDo reaches each venue through whichever rail that venue supports — Square and Mindbody for partnered venues, OpenTable and Yelp for restaurants that use them, the venue's own booking site where one exists, and a WhatsDo team member who completes the request by hand otherwise. Before booking, the app reports which rail applies and what the venue requires, so the details being submitted are visible first.

Confirmation depends on the venue. Some rails confirm inside the conversation; others return a request that stays pending until the venue or the WhatsDo team completes it, and the app reports that status rather than describing a table as held. Cancellation works the same way: it is requested in the conversation and reported as requested until the venue confirms it.

It also knows the signed-in person. Their saved location means they need not name their city; their saved diet, cuisines, price range and vibes shape the ranking; their exclusions keep places they have rejected out of the results. With Google Calendar connected, it can check a proposed time against what they already have on.

WhatsDo currently covers California and Florida.
payload.longDescription:
WhatsDo将关于外出的对话转化为场所实际接收的预订。

当您要求晚餐、按摩、健身课程或接待来访朋友的地点时，WhatsDo会返回经过排序的本地场所信息，包含照片、评分、营业时间以及是否支持通过应用预订。对于支持预订的场所，预订操作会在同一对话中完成；对于不支持的场所，WhatsDo会说明情况并提供电话号码或场所自有预订页面。

覆盖范围包括：餐厅、咖啡馆、酒吧和夜生活场所、健身房和瑜伽馆及其他健身场所、水疗中心、美发沙龙、按摩服务、宠物服务、酒店、活动和赛事。

预订方式：WhatsDo通过场所支持的预订渠道对接每个场所——合作场所使用Square和Mindbody，使用这些平台的餐厅使用OpenTable和Yelp，有自有预订网站的场所则通过该网站，其他情况由WhatsDo团队成员手动完成请求。预订前，应用会显示适用的渠道及场所要求，确保提交的详情可被查看。

确认状态取决于场所。部分渠道可在对话内确认，其他情况会返回待处理请求，直至场所或WhatsDo团队完成操作，应用会显示该状态而非描述为已预留座位。取消操作方式相同：在对话中发起取消并显示为已请求，直至场所确认。

它还能识别登录用户。用户保存的位置意味着无需说明所在城市；用户保存的饮食偏好、菜系、价格范围和氛围偏好会塑造排序结果；用户排除的地点会从结果中过滤。当连接Google日历时，它还能检查拟议时间是否与已有日程冲突。

WhatsDo目前覆盖加利福尼亚州和佛罗里达州。

payload.name: Donde Onde Where

Ask about a city and you get its neighbourhoods, with venue counts and how active each one is. Ask about a neighbourhood and you get its Hot List. The Hot Score is DOW's own momentum measure: it reacts to recent review activity, rating baseline and how complete a venue's profile is. It shows who is gaining attention now, not who is already famous. Ask about a venue by name and you get DOW's verdict: what to book it for, its signature dishes, what it suits, its rating, review count and average spend.

Two further tools cover what is new and what is being noticed. One returns the venues that most recently crossed DOW's editorial threshold in a city. The other reports whether a named venue appears in DOW's own AI-citation probes across several assistants, and states the sample size.

The index is maintained, not scraped once: venue data is collected through the month and the Hot Lists are republished as one edition on the 1st of each month. New venues are added as they qualify. Chains, cafes and bakeries are excluded on purpose. Coverage is specific cities and neighbourhoods, not whole countries, and it grows; ask for the current list.

Everything is read-only. There is no account, no sign-in and no advertising. It returns public venue information only, with no personal data and no individual reviewer identities.

Donde Onde Where is a publication of booteek AI Limited.

There is no need to switch between different tools just to play and learn. The chessboard and the conversation work together. You make a move, ask a question, get an answer, and keep playing. Everything happens in one place, making practice smooth and enjoyable.

Whether you play one game a week or many games every day, the app is ready. Beginners can build confidence. Casual players can have fun. Club players can explore ideas. Anyone who enjoys chess can have interesting conversations while playing.

Use the app to play complete games, test new ideas, understand difficult positions, review finished games, and discover better moves. Learn at your own pace. Stay curious.
